shared_tail.surface: مصعب بن سعد بن، أبي وقاص

notes: «ح» splits two branches; «قالا حدثنا» joins Muhammad b. al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar, so the names after the second «ح» are one shared tail (Hakam, Mus'ab, Sa'd)
the saying is Sa'd's report; «علي بن أبي طالب» in «خلف رسول الله ... علي» is in the scene, not a link
